notes.title: Major Update!!
notes.content:
[h1]First Major Update[/h1]

It's been about 6 months since Walk to the Woods was released and we're happy to say we have our first major update! This includes a bunch of free content including, 300+ new questions, special sets, and new features!

[h1]13 New Special Sets![/h1]

We have a wide variety of new special sets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42379761/d6745216b8feacdd711809c81826755918b2904e.gif[/img]

[*] [b]ADHD[/b]: Questions designed for people who have ADHD or might have ADHD. 
[*] [b]Agree or Disagree[/b] Questions are now hot takes. Do you agree with them or disagree with them?
[*] [b]The Check Up[/b]: Questions that are about how your week has gone.
[*] [b]Cosplay[/b]: Questions for groups of people who make or wear cosplays.
[*] [b]Couples IV[/b]: Questions for couples that have been together for years. 
[*] [b]Finger Down[/b]: Put up ten fingers. Every time you've done what the prompt says, tell the story and put a finger down. Least amount of fingers at the end wins! 
[*] [b]Food[/b]: Questions relating to your relationship to food.
[*] [b]New Friend[/b]: A set designed for someone you just met and want to slowly get to know.
[*] [b]Martial Arts[/b]: Questions for groups of people who have all done martial arts in some way before.
[*] [b]Streamers[/b]: Questions for groups of people who are all streamers of some kind.
[*] [b]Thought Provoking[/b]: Questions that are just interesting questions, but aren't designed to focus on the players themselves. 
[*] [b]Time Capsule[/b]: Questions designed to be recorded so you can see your answers in the future.
[*] [b]Transgender[/b]: Questions for groups of people who are transgender/non-binary. 

[h1]Special Set Options[/h1]

Previously, special sets that randomly selected questions from pool could select questions from any intensity. That means players expecting simple questions about Art, might get a vulnerable question without wanting to or being asked about it. Now, there's options to turn those off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42379761/fc167fd60d73e16bbc9795ca293ea10b35e531dc.gif[/img]

[h1]Replace Question in Random Special Sets[/h1]

Some special sets grab questions from a pool of questions, like Call Outs, Art, and Video Games. Despite having a pool of questions, much like the main game, there wasn't a way to replace a question until now! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42379761/d531f5b530acd825736552edc2bb68c61ee4bae7.gif[/img]

[h1]New Tension Breaker: Activities![/h1]

We've been wanting to add little activity mini games ever since we made the Couples special sets. To finally get that in, we added the Activities tension breaker! These are really simple and short games that last between a 30 seconds to a minute. We have the disabled by default, and some of the new special sets will include them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42379761/b9d1a78ae9d1ef9f59a1ec2bf4786a9948f55b3c.gif[/img]

[h1]60+ New Base Questions[/h1]

We've created at least 1 new question for every pair of intensity and topic in the game!

[h1]Special Backgrounds[/h1]

For certain LGBT+ holidays, we've created sky backgrounds that match different LGBT+ flags! They'll only show up during those holidays, so be on the lookout!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[*] Fixed a bug where hitting enter on the Show Accessible UI toggle would double press it and not open the accessible UI.
[*] Fixed a bug where swapping between the accessible intensity menu and the regular menu wouldn't save the changes from the previous menu.
[*] Fixed a bug in the accessible menu where the effective click range of the start intensities were overlapping the end intensities.
